setup/common: Do not start cni-dhcp before /opt/cni/bin/dhcp exists.
Retain SynthRAN host-safety and idempotence handling.
setup/netplan: Accept controller-selected netplan_config_file instead of reference-relative host files.
setup/pre_k8s: Honor the selected storage device and bind a containerd subdirectory when that device is already mounted.
setup/k8s/k8s_setup: Consume SynthRAN's version-pinned Kubernetes baseline instead of the reference hardcoded package version.
setup/k8s/cluster_create: Install checksum-pinned CNI plugins before cni-dhcp can start.
Keep generated join material under the private execution tree before worker join.
setup/k8s/cluster_join: Move admin and join material only through the private execution tree with restrictive permissions.
setup/k8s/cni_dhcp: SynthRAN-only ordering adapter: require executable /opt/cni/bin/dhcp before service installation/start.

caller_policy.fresh: May run host/runtime/storage/Kubernetes mutation roles after resource preparation.
caller_policy.preserve: Verification-only; must not run reset, storage mutation, package installation, cluster creation, join, taint, or tuning roles.
